title: SDK Resiliency Orchestrator — Patterns and Ops Playbook
author: Maya Patel
summary: Operational patterns, configuration templates, and an incident runbook for the Developer SDK Resiliency Orchestrator (devx-orchestrator). This page consolidates recommended retry/circuit-breaker defaults, local emulation guidance, canonical fixes for frequent SDK failures, and dashboard/alert playbooks for oncall.
body:
Overview:

Purpose: Provide a single, developer-facing reference for making Redwood SDK integrations resilient in production. This doc covers the Resiliency Orchestrator design (devx-orchestrator), recommended client-side adapters (sdk-sidecar and light adapters), rollout steps for changes to timeout/retry behavior, and concrete ops runbooks for the most common support issues.

Scope: Applies to all official Redwood SDKs (js/ts/python/go) and official client adapters maintained in the devx repo. Does NOT replace per-product SLA or pricing docs.

Architecture (high level):
- devx-orchestrator: central policy service that publishes dynamic resilience configs (retry budgets, circuit breaker thresholds, rate-limit windows) via a lightweight xDS-like config feed.
- sdk-sidecar: optional local process that translates SDK call patterns to orchestration policy and exposes a local fallback endpoint (127.0.0.1:11337).
- devx-local-stub: lightweight deterministic stub used for offline developer loops and integration tests.
- telemetry: metrics emitted to telemetry-prod/metrics with tags: sdk.language, route, model, customer_tier. Trace spans in jaeger-devx; logs in Loki under job=sdk-sidecar.

Key patterns and recommendations:
1) Bulkhead + Circuit Breaker: limit concurrent outbound requests per host and open circuit on >5% error rate sustained for 60s. Prefer request hedging for high-value low-latency routes.
2) Retry Policy: idempotent-only automatic retries. Default conservative client retry: max_attempts=2, base_backoff=150ms, max_backoff=2s, jitter=0.2. Do not retry on 4xx except 429.
3) Token-level Rate Limit Fallback: when token quota exhausted, fall back to a lower-cost model variant (model.routing policy) or degrade to embeddings-only flow if acceptable.
4) Local Emulation: use devx-local-stub with deterministic canned responses for UI and unit tests; ensure tests run with --stub-mode to avoid flakiness.
5) Graceful Fallback Chains: preferred sequence on failure: (1) SDK cache lookup -> (2) local stub -> (3) reduced-quality model variant -> (4) queued retry -> (5) soft-fail with UX-friendly message.

Configuration table (recommended defaults):
| Setting | Default | Rationale | Owner |
|---------|---------|-----------|-------|
| request_timeout | 8s | Covers typical generation call P90 + buffer | sdk-platform
| max_concurrent_per_route | 50 | Prevents head-of-line blocking | devx-orchestrator
| circuit_error_rate_window | 60s | Window for computing error rate | devx-orchestrator
| circuit_error_threshold | 5% | Opens circuit when exceeded | devx-orchestrator
| retry_max_attempts | 2 | Conservative retries to avoid amplification | sdk-libs
| retry_base_backoff_ms | 150 | Initial backoff for quick recovery | sdk-libs
| token_fallback_model | rdl-compact-1 | Lower cost/latency fallback model | model-onboarding

Operational metrics to instrument (canonical names):
- devx.sdk.requests.count (tags: route, model, status_code)
- devx.sdk.latency_ms.p50/p90/p99 (tags: route, model)
- devx.sdk.errors.rate (tags: error_type, route)
- devx.orch.circuit_open.count (tags: route, reason)
- devx.sidecar.cache.hit_rate (tags: sdk.language)

Dashboards & Alerts (owners):
- SDK Health Overview (dashboards/devx/sdk-health) — owner: devx-observability
- Alerts:
  - Alert: SDK Error Surge -> trigger when devx.sdk.errors.rate > 1% for 5m on critical routes -> pager to eng-oncall (SLO: respond 15 min).
  - Alert: Circuit Open Storm -> when devx.orch.circuit_open.count spikes by >200% -> notify devx-sre.
  - Alert: Local Stub Usage > 10% in prod -> warning to developer-ops (indicates misconfiguration).

Incident runbook: Common scenarios and steps

1) Symptom: Elevated client errors (5xx) for a specific route
- Immediate: Identify spike via dashboards -> isolate route and model in question (filter by route tag).
- Short-term mitigation: Use devx-orchestrator -> set circuit for route to OPEN for 60s to shed load; deploy temporary routing to fallback model (rdl-compact-1).
- Commands:
  - kubectl port-forward svc/devx-orchestrator 8080:8080 && curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/v1/config/update -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","action":"open_circuit","duration_s":60}'
  - kubectl rollout restart deployment/sdk-sidecar -n sdk || true
- Postmortem tasks: capture example failing requests, escalate to model-onboarding if model quality regressions seen.

2) Symptom: Increased client-side timeouts from SDKs
- Check: devx.sdk.latency_ms.p99 and upstream model latency metrics. If upstream slow, apply short-circuit (local stub) for callers making non-critical calls.
- Mitigation: temporarily lower concurrency for affected route: devx-orchestrator API to set max_concurrent_per_route=20.
- Follow up: add per-route p99 budget in SDK telemetry to catch regressions.

3) Symptom: SDK integration tests intermittently failing in CI after a dependency bump
- Local reproduction: run tests with --stub-mode; if stable, root cause is external flakiness.
- Fix: pin devx-local-stub fixtures in CI and add flaky-test retry wrapper to CI pipeline. Update quickstart README with version pin.

Change rollout procedure for resiliency config changes:
1) Create change in devx-config repo with rationale and test plan.
2) Canary publish to devx-orchestrator in dev env for 24 hours with percentage rollouts: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%.
3) Monitor devx.sdk.errors.rate and devx.sdk.latency_ms.p90 during rollout. Roll back automatically if errors increase >2x baseline or p90 latency increases by >50%.
4) Owner must file a short release note in #devx-announcements and link to the config PR.

Canonical fixes (top support issues):
- Problem: SDK calls intermittently return 502 with no body.
  - Fix: Update http client to include 'Connection: keep-alive' and increase request_timeout to 12s for long-poll routes. Ensure edge LB (ingress-nginx) has proxy_read_timeout >= request_timeout.
- Problem: High duplicate tokens billed due to aggressive retries.
  - Fix: Honor idempotency keys for generation requests; only retry safe request types. Add telemetry devx.sdk.retries.count to identify offenders.
- Problem: Unexpected local stub usage in production.
  - Fix: baked-in environment detection; disable stub by default in prod images and add guard rails in SDK init that require ALLOW_STUBS=true.

Developer guidance and quickstart steps:
- Local dev sandbox:
  1. Start devx-local-stub: ./bin/devx-local-stub --fixtures ./test/fixtures &
  2. Start sdk-sidecar in dev-mode: ./scripts/sdk-sidecar --mode dev --orchestrator http://localhost:8080
  3. Run unit tests: pytest tests/ --stub-mode
- Running the orchestrator locally:
  - docker-compose up devx-orchestrator (see devx/orchestrator/docker-compose.yml).

Ownership and escalation:
- Primary owner: devx-platform (pager: eng-oncall, alias: +1-555-0102)
- Observability owner: devx-observability
- Model fallback policy owner: model-onboarding team
